iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

CLASSIFICATION::category
       Deprecated: Provides classification category name.

SYNOPSIS
       CLASSIFICATION::category

DESCRIPTION
       This command provides classification category name. (Example: mail, gaming) * Note: APM / AFM / PEM license is required for
       functionality to work.

       Syntax CLASSIFICATION::category

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED

EXAMPLES
	when CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED {
	  if { [CLASSIFICATION::category] equals "chat"}  {
	    drop
	  }
	}

HINTS
       CLASSIFICATION::result replaces this command

SEE ALSO
       CLASSIFICATION::result

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.  @BIGIP-12.0.0 -- Deprecated in favor of CLASSIFY namespace

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
